Op.name: Op
Op.summary: One change to the page. The runtime handles exactly this list.

constructors.name: navigate
constructors.doc: Goes to `href`, on this site: a URL that would leave it goes nowhere.

constructors.name: navigate_external
constructors.doc: Leaves for `href`, which may be on another site. Never give this a URL from a request unchecked: that is an open redirect.

constructors.name: url
constructors.doc: Changes the address bar, on this site.

variants.name: Morph
variants.doc: Morphs the element `target` into `html`, keeping focus, caret, selection, composition and typed values.

variants.name: Errors
variants.doc: Shows field errors in a form, or clears them when `fields` is empty.

variants.name: Toast
variants.doc: Shows a toast, and announces it to assistive technology.

variants.name: Open
variants.doc: Opens the dialog, popover or details `target`.

variants.name: Close
variants.doc: Closes the dialog, popover or details `target`.

variants.name: Url
variants.doc: Changes the address bar without loading anything.

variants.name: Navigate
variants.doc: Goes to `href`, on this site, the way a boosted link does. The runtime refuses another origin here.

variants.name: NavigateExternal
variants.doc: Leaves for `href` on another site: a real navigation, with no request of the runtime's. Only `Op::navigate_external` and `Reply::redirect_external` write this.

Region.name: Region
Region.summary: A named part of a page that updates by itself: fetched after paint, polled, or refetched when an op invalidates it. Its answer morphs in.

methods.name: src
methods.doc: Sets where its content comes from: a page holding an element with this id, or a fragment, which is a page with no script of its own. A page with the runtime that lacks this id, or a redirect, is somewhere else: the user goes there, as when a session has ended.

methods.name: lazy
methods.doc: Fetches it after paint, showing a skeleton until then.

methods.name: poll
methods.doc: Refetches it this often, while the page is visible.

methods.name: feed
methods.args: into: impl Into<AttrValue>, after: impl Into<AttrValue>, empty: Option<&str>
methods.doc: Makes it a feed: each poll asks the source for what is newer than a cursor and adds it at the start of the element `into` inside the region, instead of fetching the whole region again.

methods.name: children
methods.doc: Adds its content.

Reply.name: Reply
Reply.summary: What an action handler answers: ops for the runtime, and what a browser with JavaScript off gets instead.

constructors.name: redirect
constructors.doc: Goes to `href`, on this site. A URL that would leave it (`//host`, `/\\host`, `https://host`) goes nowhere, so a `next` from a request can't send a user away. To leave on purpose, use `redirect_external`.

constructors.name: ops_or_redirect
constructors.doc: Applies ops; with JavaScript off, goes to `href`.

constructors.name: redirect_external
constructors.doc: Goes to `href`, which may be on another site: a sign-in provider, a payment page. Never give this a URL from a request unchecked: that is an open redirect.

constructors.name: view
constructors.doc: Applies ops; with JavaScript off, shows `view`.
